notes.title: Game Over Please Release
notes.content:
🚀ːsteamthumbsupː Get Ready for Frustration and Fun! 

[previewyoutube=HAS6i6meHDI;full][/previewyoutube]

We are excited to announce the launch of our new game, Game Over Please, on [spoiler]October 17th[/spoiler], 2024! This game challenges your skills with a simple task: guide a ball into a pipe. But don’t be fooled — the journey is filled with creative obstacles that will push your limits!

🌀 What to Expect:

 95 challenging levels: Each level is a new adventure through a maze of obstacles designed to test your skills.
 Intuitive controls: Use your mouse to guide the ball with precision, but be prepared for increasing complexity that will require quick reflexes and strategy.
 Guaranteed frustration: Every mistake is a learning opportunity! You’ll be so close to victory that persistence will become your best friend.
 Unmatched satisfaction: The final reward is for those who never give up!


🖱️ Join Us!
Visit the link below to learn more and get ready for the fun:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3155320/Game_Over_Please/

Don’t miss your chance to challenge yourself and have a blast! Mark your calendar and get ready for the launch!
